episodes.title: Not So Happy Campers - Part 1
episodes.summary: The campers arrive and learn the horrible truth – that instead of chilling in a gorgeous mansion with a hot tub, they'll be spending the next 8 weeks at crappy old Camp Wawanakwa! They also realise that they have almost nothing in common – this could be a loooong summer. After being divided into two teams, The Screaming Gophers and The Killer Bass, they are about to come face to face with their first challenge.

episodes.title: Not So Happy Campers - Part 2
episodes.summary: The campers must jump off of an insanely high cliff into shark-infested waters, then carry a cartload of materials back to the campgrounds and build a hot tub from scratch. The losers will send their first camper down the Dock of Shame.

episodes.title: The Big Sleep
episodes.summary: The campers face off in an epic 'awake-a-thon'. Heather makes up one of the first strategic alliances with hapless minions Beth and Lindsay, and Gwen crushes on Trent big time. But it's Eva's raging temper that causes the biggest drama when her Mp3 player is 'stolen'. She freaks out and locks her entire team out of their cabin and turns it upside down.

episodes.title: Dodgebrawl
episodes.summary: The campers face off in the classic school-yard-blood-bath: dodge-ball. After losing two challenges in a row, The Killer Bass are the underdogs and do not expect to win. Heather solidifies her alliance with Lindsay and Beth and promptly lays down the law… which unfortunately for Lindsay includes not dating members of the other team. But how can she resist Tyler's charms?! Will Lindsay get kicked out of the alliance?

episodes.title: Not Quite Famous
episodes.summary: The campers step on stage for the most dramatic elimination yet! Chef Hatchet will use his Chef-O-Meter to vote on which team has the most talent and which team must send a player to the Loser Boat. Tensions are high in the Gopher camp when Gwen dares to cross Queen Bee Heather. Heather gets revenge by stealing Gwen's diary and doing a "dramatic reading" of it in front of the entire world.

episodes.title: The Sucky Outdoors
episodes.summary: An overnight camping trip into the woods brings out the crazy in Izzy. She dons a bear costume to play a joke on her teammates... but ends up attracting a real grizzly with a crush on her to their site and the Gophers are forced to spend the entire night up in a tree. The Bass also have a sleepless night after Duncan tells a horror story by the fire and Bridgette accidentally burns down their tent.

episodes.title: Phobia Factor
episodes.summary: Each camper is forced to face their biggest fear. Beth surprises all when she turns out to be one fearless cookie, and Gwen and Trent bond as they help one another conquer their phobias. Geoff makes a few moves on Bridgette but they are the worst moves ever. Courtney, in an effort to project strength as a means to leadership, claims she's not afraid of anything – then has to face the most outrageously scary stunt of them all.

episodes.title: Up the Creek
episodes.summary: The campers participate in a 3 part canoe race to Boney Island, the Deadliest Place in Muskoka and home to an ancient pet cemetery / ritualistic sacrificial ground / blah blah really scary place, dude. Beth does her team in when she brings home a Tiki doll as a souvenir from Boney Island. Will this bad luck omen wear off on the Screaming Gophers? Or will it last, say the next TWO episodes until they figure out what she's done?

episodes.title: Paintball Deer Hunter
episodes.summary: The campers are split up into Deer and Hunters, and each team has to go out and bag as many of the other team's deer as possible. Duncan and Courtney's antlers get locked – literally and metaphorically. Could their love-hate relationship be the hottest hookup yet on TDI?

episodes.title: If You Can't Take the Heat...
episodes.summary: The two teams must make a 3 course meal. The Killer Bass, lead by Geoff, prepare an awesome meal and everything runs smoothly. The love you/hate you thing heats up between Duncan and Courtney, and Geoff and Beth grow closer. Meanwhile, relations on the Gopher team get worse. The team locks Heather in the walk-in fridge, then makes the grave tactical error of leaving Owen in charge of guarding the dinner they've prepared.

episodes.title: Who Can You Trust?
episodes.summary: Given the growing tensions on both teams, what better way to mess with the campers than force them to trust one another? The campers are put through three "trust" challenges including extreme rock climbing, preparing your partner a deadly blowfish dinner, and a deadly blindfolded obstacle course.

episodes.title: Basic Straining
episodes.summary: The campers are sent to an insane boot camp, Chef Hatchet style, and you better believe it's going to be rough. The only rule – they go until everyone drops out and one camper is left standing.

episodes.title: X-Treme Torture
episodes.summary: The campers are challenged to participate in an X-treme Sports Challenge including - Sofa Bed Skydiving, Mechanical Moose Rodeo Riding and Seadoo Water-skiing (on dry land!) While the majority of the Gopher and Bass Teams are playing to win the coveted multi massage mobile shower, Gwen and Bridgette are busy trying to figure out who wrote the corny Haiku poem that was found in the Main Lodge.

episodes.title: Brunch of Disgustingness
episodes.summary: The campers have reached the halfway point. Their reward is no vote-off this week. Their challenge: eat a nine course meal of disgusting stuff, including live grasshopper & anchovies pizza and bunion soup with hangnail crackers.

episodes.title: No Pain, No Game
episodes.summary: The teams are officially dissolved. It's every ruthless camper for themselves in a high stakes game of NO PAIN, NO GAME, where contestants answer Trivia Questions or spin the Wheel of Misfortune and endure painful punishments.

episodes.title: Search and Do Not Destroy
episodes.summary: This week the camp scallywags set out on ye olde "Scavenger Hunt for Treasure" challenge. They must find the 'keys' to the treasure chest, which are put in dangerous places, like dangling off a pole surrounded by circling sharks.

episodes.title: Hide and Be Sneaky
episodes.summary: The campers are in for an old fashioned game of Hide N' Seek, with Chef Hatchet as their seeker, and when you combine his guerilla tactics, super soaker water-gun and hate-on for the campers, let's just say, this guy means business!

episodes.title: That's Off the Chain!
episodes.summary: The campers are challenged to compete in The Tour de Wawanakwa where they must not only race a treacherous Motor Cross Course, but build their own bicycles using supplies from the Arts & Crafts Lodge.

episodes.title: Hook, Line and Screamer
episodes.summary: One by one, our campers disappear, unaware that this whole reign of horror is just another challenge orchestrated by show's producers. What no one knows is that there really is a psycho killer loose, and preying on campers.

episodes.title: Wawanakwa Gone Wild!
episodes.summary: The campers are challenged to become Game Wardens and bag a beast. They have eight hours to trap a forest creature but first they have to forage in the creepy boathouse for hunting tools.

episodes.title: Trial by Tri-Armed Triathalon
episodes.summary: The campers are paired up in teams again - only these are the most unholy alliances ever dreamt up by Chris. All three teams are literally handcuffed together in a twisted version of a Triathalon.

episodes.title: Haut Camp-ture
episodes.summary: The remaining campers are left alone on the island for a little well deserved rest and relaxation while the contestants that have been voted off up to this point finally get to have their say.

episodes.title: Camp Castaways
episodes.summary: A heavy rainstorm washes away the cabins and Duncan, Gwen and Heather wake up in the middle of Lake Leech with no idea where they are. They paddle the remains of their cabin to a nearby beach, but are spooked by the surroundings.

episodes.title: Are We There, Yeti?
episodes.summary: The campers have a rude awakening when they wake up in the middle of the wilderness. Sergeant Chef puts his troops through a grueling mission. They must find base camp with only the sparsest of supplies.

episodes.title: I Triple Dog Dare You
episodes.summary: In the semi-final round, Heather, Gwen & Owen are forced to play a game of I TRIPLE DOG DARE YOU, a twisted version of "spin the bottle meets truth or dare."

episodes.title: The Very Last Episode, Really!
episodes.summary: Owen and Gwen's former teammates have been invited back to watch the last challenge - and some of them are even participating! The final challenge - a long distance "Rejected Olympic" run. Who will win the 100,000!!!

episodes.title: Monster Cash
episodes.summary: They're back! Fourteen of our season one competitors have returned for the chance to win... One. Million. Dollars.

episodes.title: Alien Resurr-eggtion
episodes.summary: Fourteen cast mates embark on an epic search for alien eggs in our alien movie-themed challenge, while Chef, a.k.a. Mama Alien, tracks their every move.

episodes.title: Riot on Set
episodes.summary: After winning last week's challenge, cute couple Gwen and Trent find themselves with a 'reward' - they're forced to pick teams and compete against each other!

episodes.title: Beach Blanket Bogus
episodes.summary: Trent and Gwen have made up after last week's challenge - at least initially, as the teams learn that this week's movie genre is the classic teen beach flick.

episodes.title: 3:10 to Crazytown
episodes.summary: During an epic heat wave, the cast are thrust into a western movie-themed challenge against their will.

episodes.title: Aftermath I: Trent's Descent
episodes.summary: Geoff and Bridgette, our first two cast members ousted from this season's competition, welcome us to the totally off-the-hook Total Drama Action aftermath show!

episodes.title: The Chefshank Redemption
episodes.summary: A rude awakening finds all the guys and girls locked in their trailers as prep for today's prison movie showdown.

episodes.title: One Flu Over the Cuckoos
episodes.summary: The campers are thrown into med-school and forced to cram all night for the medical drama to follow.

episodes.title: The Sand Witch Project
episodes.summary: When Chris dramatically drops in on the cast, complete with fake blood spatters, everyone realises that it's time for the horror movie challenge.

episodes.title: Masters of Disasters
episodes.summary: The cast miss DJ's delicious cooking as they are tempted to lose their disgusting lunch on this week's disaster movie-themed challenges.

episodes.title: Full Metal Drama
episodes.summary: The Screaming Gaffers are falling apart at the seams, with the ongoing strife between Harold and Duncan only escalating by the day.

episodes.title: Aftermath II: For-Gwen and Forget
episodes.summary: Geoff and Bridgette welcome us to another super juicy episode of the Total Drama Action aftermath show!

episodes.title: Ocean's Eight - Or Nine
episodes.summary: This week's bank heist challenge starts with the teams having to blow a safe and rescue either Owen or Leshawna from within, along with some bank robbing tools.

episodes.title: One Million Bucks B.C.
episodes.summary: Ooga Ooga. Dig up the hatchets everyone because Courtney is back!

episodes.title: Million Dollar Babies
episodes.summary: Cue the marching band and prepare to cut the finish ribbon - because it's sports movie day on Total Drama Action.

episodes.title: Dial M for Merger
episodes.summary: The seven remaining cast mates embark on this week's spy-movie themed challenge as the teams are merged.

episodes.title: Super Hero-Id
episodes.summary: There's nothing scarier than waking up to the sound of someone screaming in terror.

episodes.title: Aftermath III: O-wen or Lose
episodes.summary: Geoff and Bridgette welcome us to another spectacularly juicy, behind-the-scenes episode of the Total Drama Action aftermath show!

episodes.title: The Princess Pride
episodes.summary: When Chris shows up with a glass combat boot, the contestants know it's time to bust open the conventions of a fairy tale movie.

episodes.title: Get a Clue
episodes.summary: And then there were five... The gloves are off and the magnifying glasses are out, as Chris declares this week the mystery movie challenge.

episodes.title: Rock 'n Rule
episodes.summary: Strap on those air guitars! 'Cause this is the week to rock 'n' roll!

episodes.title: Crouching Courtney, Hidden Owen
episodes.summary: GONG! It's the girls (Beth and Courtney) versus the boys (Harold and Duncan) as Chris declares this episode's kung fu challenge.

episodes.title: 2008: A Space Owen
episodes.summary: The five remaining cast mates embark on a challenge that's 'out of this world' in this week's outer space extravaganza

episodes.title: Top Dog
episodes.summary: Four remaining cast mates embark on this week's animal/buddy flick, forced to bond with creatures of the fur and feather variety.

episodes.title: Mutiny on the Soundstage
episodes.summary: It's down to Beth and Duncan, as the competition accelerates into the final episodes!

episodes.title: Aftermath IV: Who Wants to Pick a Millionaire?
episodes.summary: Beth and Duncan are on pins and needles as they're forced to sit through an aftermath show...

episodes.title: Walk Like an Egyptian - Part 1
episodes.summary: New season, new rules: Total Drama is back, and this time it's international! Chris and Chef are flying competitors all over the world (in a huge decrepit plane) to compete for a million big ones

episodes.title: Walk Like an Egyptian - Part 2
episodes.summary: Now that the competitors have been separated into three teams (Team Victory, Team Amazon, and Team Chris Is Really Really Really Really Hot), Chris gives them their next challenge – a race to the Nile.

episodes.title: Super Crazy Happy Fun Time Japan
episodes.summary: As the teams begin to gel – or not, in the case of the wildly different girls that make up Team Amazon – Chris announces that the competition's next stop will be Japan.

episodes.title: Anything Yukon Do, I Can Do Better
episodes.summary: The frozen tundra of the northern Yukon. The challenge: jump ice floes across a frigid waterway, then pull a dogsled to collect your teammates and race to a finish line, all without freezing to death!

episodes.title: Broadway, Baby!
episodes.summary: New York City. Teams must get baby carriages from the Statue of Liberty's crown and race them through Central Park.

episodes.title: Aftermath I: Bridgette Over Troubled Waters
episodes.summary: The Aftermath Studio. Geoff co-hosts with Blaineley because Bridgette's in the competition, unlike the Peanut Gallery of disgruntled almost-rans – Trent, Justin, Sadie, Katie, Beth and Eva.

episodes.title: Slap Slap Revolution
episodes.summary: The German Alps. The teams are dumped into avalanche territory and have to sing softly or risk a ‘song-alanche.'

episodes.title: The Am-AH-Zon Race
episodes.summary: The Peruvian jungle. Heather is miserable, still smarting from the Leshawna beat-down and missing a tooth to boot!

episodes.title: Can't Help Falling in Louvre
episodes.summary: Paris – the city of love, and of the Louvre. Chris has hidden pieces of the world's most famous statues throughout the world's most famous museum, and the teams scramble to find and assemble the statues in the museum's renowned pyramid court.

episodes.title: Newf Kids on the Rock
episodes.summary: It's an exciting homecoming for Chris, back to his birthplace on the East Coast of Canada and the storied Grand Banks of Newfoundland.

episodes.title: Jamaica Me Sweat
episodes.summary: In the plane en route to Jamaica, DJ is sure his luck has changed. With lucky fish Irene at his side, nothing can go wrong.

episodes.title: Aftermath II: Revenge of the Telethon
episodes.summary: The Aftermath Set. Tonight Geoff and Bridgette (and their annoying co-host, Blaineley) have a huge task – they need to raise $500,000 so Chris can refuel the plane and get everyone out of Jamaica!

episodes.title: I See London...
episodes.summary: The refueld airplane finally makes it to London - and with DJ gone, only two teams remain! Amazons Gwen and Courtney are amazed to realize how much they have in common – and how pleased they are about it.

episodes.title: Greece's Pieces
episodes.summary: Athens, Greece. Courtney is elated to have Duncan back – and Gwen is a bundle of conflicted nerves since she just kissed her kinda-friend Courtney's boyfriend in the confessional!

episodes.title: The Ex-Files
episodes.summary: Area 51. (Okay, technically, 52. But 51 is right next door!) The tension amongst the players is unbearable. Duncan's still enemy number one in Team CIRRRH, and Gwen's become the new 'Heather', despised by the rest of Team Amazon. The only one having a good time is Heather - finally, the target's off her back! The challenge: to sneak into Area 51's Black Box warehouse and steal a functioning alien artifact without getting caught by an elite Black Ops security detail.

episodes.title: Picnic at Hanging Dork
episodes.summary: Australia. Gwen and Duncan can't believe they survived the last elimination round; both know they're still targets. Alejandro didn't eliminate Duncan because the punk may still be useful. So he leads Duncan into suggesting Alejandro seduce his ex, since it will throw both Courtney and Heather off their games. Courtney can't wait to lose and vote Gwen out - and if that means not doing her personal best, Courtney's willing to make that sacrifice. The challenge: an emu race up the Blue Mountains to Hanging Rock, followed by a bungie-jumping, sheep shearing competition.

episodes.title: Sweden Sour
episodes.summary: The frozen waters of Sweden. Owen tells Duncan Noah's theories (ie. that Alejandro is evil and majorly into Heather), and Duncan tries to make Owen see that Alejandro is the enemy while Alejandro works to regain Owen's blind trust. The challenge: first, each team must build a mystery object which turns out to be...a Viking ship! Teams must drag their 'ships' to water and sail to Chef to get their final task: pick a Captain then either race to the finish line, or try and sink their opponents by firing Swedish meatball cannonballs!

episodes.title: Aftermath III: Aftermath Aftermayhem
episodes.summary: Geoff is thrilled to announce Blaineley is gone, doing a world tour of countries where Total Drama is a hit. But where's Bridgette? Blaineley appears and reveals that she tricked Bridgette into leaving the country instead! Bridgette calls in from Siberia, shivering, and begs Geoff to appease her host, a pissed off Blaineley 'SuperFan,' by singing a country song about Blaineley. Tonight's big announcement: someone from the Peanut Gallery is going to get sent back into the big game to compete for the million!

episodes.title: Niagara Brawls
episodes.summary: The contestants have a rather rude awakening on their return home to Canada - because they are dropped into the rushing waters of the Great Lakes, just meters from the destructive wonder of Niagara Falls! After a daring escape, they are startled to find that Chris is now dissolving the teams. He decides to take the opportunity to pair them up for what may be the most emotionally challenging competition yet, and teams of one boy and one girl must compete in races based on Niagara Falls' historical place as the 'Honeymoon Capital of the World'. After a blindfolded trust challenge leads each bride to a wedding gown, the couples must walk a tiny tightrope over the falls and get through 'U.S. Customs' (AKA Chef, in a little booth and a particularly foul mood.)

episodes.title: Chinese Fake-Out
episodes.summary: The next stop on the show's world-wide tour is exotic China, where Chris announces that each individual will be on their own for a race down the top of the Great Wall. Duncan and Alejandro work their strategic faux-friendship. Sierra, meanwhile, continues to tell Cody that they are married and he is forced to pursue desperate measures to lose her from the game. Blaineley cannily persuades Chef to help her cheat but he has a tougher time in the crazy and daring food-eating competition that follows, featuring all kinds of very authentic - and tough-to-swallow – local delicacies.

episodes.title: African Lying Safari
episodes.summary: The Serengeti, Tanzania. Cody is deliriously weak thanks to the love potion tea Sierra keeps pouring down his throat, so Sierra turns her knapsack into a baby carrier and lugs him around, playing both for herself and for her 'husband.' The challenge: secure gear for a Safari to hunt a ferocious and wild...Ezekiel! First, players must dodge soccer balls and hit plums with cricket bats to crack open gourds containing goggles, slingshots, and tranquilizer balls.

episodes.title: Rapa Phooey!
episodes.summary: With just four contestants left, the heat is really starting to ratchet up on the battle. Alejandro's choice to bring Cody to first class proves to be brilliant strategy as Cody is desperately grateful for a night away from Sierra's obsession with him and is now willing to do anything to help Alejandro. The plane lands on Easter Island where Chris announces an 'Easter Egg Hunt' through the gigantic stone Moai heads that line the island - with a difference, since each of the heads is made up in the shape of a former competitor. When each competitor has found their coloured eggs, they must race up a lava tube in the island's rock to deposit the eggs in the nest of a supremely angry Giant Condor.

episodes.title: Awwwwww, Drumheller
episodes.summary: The Final Four take a trip to the Badlands of Alberta, Canada - the world's richest hunting grounds for paleontologists. A creative dinosaur building competition pits the four of them against each other, and Sierra's broken heart actually helps her in building a very emotional dinosaur of betrayal. Alejandro faces his own challenge in the loser's spot. When Heather gets stuck in a big hole of her own making, he must chose whether to leave his biggest competition behind - or rescue the girl he cares most about. How inconvenient that they happen to be the same person!

episodes.title: Aftermath IV: Hawaiian Style
episodes.summary: The Aftermath set - which has been moved to glorious Hawaii! Geoff and the Peanut Gallery are giddy – now this is an Aftermath. Added to the mix are returning losers and finally returning after six long weeks surrounded by Russians and meat is none other than Bridgette! Unfortunately for Geoff, Bruno the bear has come with her! But this Aftermath is all about taking sides, so the Peanut Gallery pledge allegiance to their favourite members of the Final Three. Little do they know that one member from each team will have to compete in a surfing challenge to win a prize that will aide their finalist in the finale. Of course, the surfing route goes directly over a lava spray into the awaiting jaws of a vicious animal!

episodes.title: Planes, Trains and Hot Air Mobiles
episodes.summary: Without a plane, the contestants find themselves in a manic road-trip race – all the way to the shores of Hawaii...

episodes.title: Hawaiian Punch
episodes.summary: An epic journey up the Big Island's active volcano determines a million dollar winner!

episodes.title: Bigger! Badder! Brutal-er!
episodes.summary: We're going back to the island where Total Drama began, for an all-new season with an all-new cast! Since Chris took the show worldwide, Camp Wawanakwa has been abandoned and turned into a toxic nuclear waste dump - the perfect place for a new season of painful, cringe-inducing challenges! On the first challenge of the new season: cut down giant team totems suspended over the forest and race them downriver to camp. First team gets pick of the cabins. Last team goes to the elimination ceremony, where they'll vote for a team member to get flung off the island by catapult on The Hurl of Shame.

episodes.title: Truth Or Laser Shark
episodes.summary: Challenge time! First up is the "Getting To Know You Trivia Quiz" where Chris forces the players to own up to their humiliations or risk dunking their team in the water, where a hungry four-legged shark lays in wait.

episodes.title: Ice Ice Baby
episodes.summary: Challenge Time! First, teams have to climb up a sheer cliff wall twenty stories high, using whatever they find in a junk pile guarded by a giant mutant fire-breathing beetle.

episodes.title: Finders Creepers
episodes.summary: It's a midnight scavenger hunt. Teams have to find hidden objects in a haunted forest, a creepy pet cemetery, and a spook-tacular cave. Chris warns them to stick together.

episodes.title: Backstabbers Ahoy!
episodes.summary: It's a waterski race among water mines and deadly mutant sharks! Each team must pick three skiers to ride in formation and ring three bells on various buoys, while two team members pilot the team's boat.

episodes.title: Runaway Model
episodes.summary: Chris announces that for the fashion show challenge, teams must hunt down and dress up one of the island's ferocious mutant creatures!

episodes.title: A Mine Is a Terrible Thing to Waste
episodes.summary: Teams must head into the old mine where Chris stowed all the radioactive waste, find a Golden Chris in their team colour, and bring it back to Chris, all while shouldering fifty pound backpacks.

episodes.title: The Treasure Island of Dr. McLean
episodes.summary: The campers wake up far from shore, floating on rafts. And new Maggot team member Dakota is starting to mutate. Teams must get to shore by any means possible, avoiding the giant mutant squid if they can.

episodes.title: Grand Chef Auto
episodes.summary: It's merge day! The competitors must ransack Chef's kitchen for keys, then use the keys to steal Chef's collection of go-karts. Then, it's a race around the island to graffiti-tag various locations.

episodes.title: Up, Up and Away in My Pitiful Balloon
episodes.summary: It's down to the final five. With the strongest players now the most likely to get voted off. Chris arrives in the Total Drama zeppelin to unveil the newest challenge: an aerial obstacle course.

episodes.title: Eat, Puke and Be Wary
episodes.summary: Chris plans to go easy on the players until he steps into one of Scott's snares and gets flung into the outhouse pit. Chris tells Chef to take over and to make it the most brutally insane contest yet.

episodes.title: The Enchanted Franken-Forest
episodes.summary: Chris takes the competitors to the deadly Mutant Forest of Terror, where their challenge is a search for the rare Chrisinus flower. The first to pick the flower and bring it to Chris goes to the finals.

episodes.title: Brain vs. Brawn: The Ultimate Showdown
episodes.summary: It's the big finale, for all the cash! Two competitors will enter the Chrisiseum but only one will come out! Who will be going home a millionaire? And who will be going home in a pine box?

episodes.title: Heroes vs. Villains
episodes.summary: Chris brings back players from both casts for an All-Star season and the Heroic Hamsters battle the Villainous Vultures for a night in the luxurious Spa Hotel.

episodes.title: Evil Dread
episodes.summary: The players gather on the beach to dig up 3D puzzle pieces and use them to assemble an international landmark - but that's easier said than done.

episodes.title: Saving Private Leechball
episodes.summary: The Heroic Hamsters and Villainous Vultures race into the forest to collect unusual paintball weaponry and use it to pick off the other team - last team standing wins.

episodes.title: Food Fright
episodes.summary: Chris combines a pancake-eating contest with an obstacle course in the ultimate tummy twister. Meanwhile, sparks fly between newly Villain-ised Courtney and Scott.

episodes.title: Moon Madness
episodes.summary: During a race across the island, the local wildlife is radically altered by the rare blue harvest moon, and even the littlest bunny becomes a blood-thirsty predator.

episodes.title: No One Eggspects the Spanish Opposition
episodes.summary: The teams travel to Boney Island for an egg hunt inside The Fun Zone, which is anything but fun.

episodes.title: Suckers Punched
episodes.summary: Chris orchestrates a brutal boxing free-for-all that pits the All-Stars against their biggest, baddest enemies.

episodes.title: You Regatta Be Kidding Me
episodes.summary: The challenge is a simple life-or-death boat race around the island but things get complicated when Chris messes with team dynamics.

episodes.title: Zeek and Ye Shall Find
episodes.summary: The 100th episode celebrations are cut short when Ezekiel kidnaps Chris, and the All-Stars head out in search of their host.

episodes.title: The Obsta-Kill Kourse
episodes.summary: The All-Stars face the Boot Camp from Hell as they struggle to survive the harshest obstacle course ever.

episodes.title: Sundae Muddy Sundae
episodes.summary: The final five All-Stars race to the most dangerous regions of the island to find ingredients for the ultimate Sundae.

episodes.title: The Bold and the Booty-ful
episodes.summary: The final four hunt for pirate treasure and a spot in the Grand Finale in a challenge that becomes truly life-threatening when Mike's malevolent alter ego gets involved.

episodes.title: The Final Wreck-ening
episodes.summary: Zoey gives up hope that she'll ever see Mike again and tells Mal the jig is up. With a little help from some of the previously eliminated, Mal and Zoey face off in a horrifying final challenge called Circles of Doom.

episodes.title: So, Uh, This Is My Team?
episodes.summary: Chris welcomes 16 fresh victims to the new island. Flaws, strengths and outright insanity are put on display during a build-your-own accommodations challenge.

episodes.title: I Love You, Grease Pig!
episodes.summary: A challenge involving a wild boar proves to be more than most can handle, but not for Sugar. Meanwhile, Dave is showing some signs that he might be crushing on a teammate.

episodes.title: Twinning Isn't Everything
episodes.summary: Samey and Amy's sisterly hatred reaches a boiling point during a game of doom balloons. Meanwhile, Max gets a little help from a new friend on his quest for pure evil.

episodes.title: I Love You, I Love You Knots
episodes.summary: Ella's attempts to befriend Sugar backfire during a wild game of Truth or Scare. Meanwhile, Rodney's delusional love triangle has a huge effect on his team's performance.

episodes.title: A Blast from the Past
episodes.summary: Great news: Sky likes Dave! Bad news: Not nearly as much as Dave likes Sky. Spooked by a possible zombie sighting, Shawn bolts and puts his team in jeopardy. A surprise visit from a past competitor raises some very serious questions about a previous elimination.

episodes.title: Mo' Monkey, Mo' Problems
episodes.summary: Ella comes up big after Dave puts himself in a dangerous spot trying to show Sky what a good boyfriend he could be. Max tangles with his team's chances to provide his superiority.

episodes.title: This Is the Pits!
episodes.summary: Jasmine reveals a deep, dark fear in a deep, dark cave; Sugar confuses buses and trains; and Dave looks for the perfect opportunity to plant his first kiss on Sky.

episodes.title: Three Zones and a Baby
episodes.summary: Sky chooses her new team over Dave. Max shows a softer side that's just as creepy as his evil side. And it all comes down when Topher gets a call from the network!

episodes.title: Hurl and Go Seek
episodes.summary: Chris merges the teams and feeds them some expired meat before the first nighttime challenge. Dave finally hears what Sky's saying and Jasmine finally sees how Shawn's feeling. Scarlett learns the truth about Pahkitew Island!

episodes.title: Scarlett Fever
episodes.summary: With the island becoming wildly volatile and deadly, Chris sends the teens underground to shut it down. Scarlett has a different plan and with only minutes to spare before Pahkitew explodes the rest of them have to stop her.

episodes.title: Sky Fall
episodes.summary: With Shawn and Jasmine obviously paired up, Sky has no choice but to form an alliance with Sugar. Jasmine and Shawn make a deal to split the money if it's the two of them in the finale… or do they?

episodes.title: Pahk'd With Talent
episodes.summary: Chris is feeling pretty lazy so he allows Shawn, Sky and Sugar to each create one challenge. Sky's is about athleticism, Shawn's is about escaping, and Sugar's is alllllll about talent!

episodes.title: Lies, Cries and One Big Prize
episodes.summary: With luck on his side Shawn gets to bring Jasmine back as his helper. Sky gets stuck with Dave. Halfway through the challenge Jasmine and Dave learn some shocking truths about their partners and the helpers become hurters!
